scope: Independent offline audit of the Koivu phone-only mappers (v1 0843f44, OctoMap v2 4f6ec41). Planner-side map/route feasibility only. No FARO input to any planner. Zero game episodes executed.

environment.octomap: octomap-python 1.10.0.0 (wraps OctoMap 1.10.0, BSD-3-Clause); default sensor model hit 0.7 miss 0.4 threshold 0.5 clamp 0.1192/0.971
environment.recast: tools/navigation-recast pinned 9f4ce64458dfae86e1239c525ddc219c4e9e06f1 rebuilt with g++ 13.3.0 (original receipts used 14.2.0); its 12 adapter tests passed
environment.machine: Linux cloud container, 4 vCPU, 15 GiB; OMP_NUM_THREADS=2 for OctoMap insertion

v1Reproduction.command: run_map_bounded.py with FROZEN.json re-pinned only for the path-normalized MAP_PROTOCOL.md text
v1Reproduction.mapNpzDifference: floating point only, max 1.8e-15 m in voxel Y extents and transforms

inputGeometryChecks.depthEncoding: uint16 millimetres, 994x738 portrait, no zero pixels
inputGeometryChecks.upsampling: nearest-neighbour 4x of 256x192 then 15 px border crop (run lengths 4, first run 1). 215,670,168 pixels = 13,415,808 independent LiDAR samples x 16 copies; v1/v2 hit counts and per-voxel frame/hit statistics count each sample up to 16 times
inputGeometryChecks.poseConvention: OpenGL camera-to-world, +Z up; consistent with 5 cm median reference agreement
inputGeometryChecks.pixelCentre: half-pixel convention correct; block-centre vs pixel ray difference <= 1.5 px (about 0.5 cm at 3 m)

floorMeasurement.method: LiDAR-native samples, 20 cm cells, mode +-6 cm then median

v2Attribution.recastNavmeshFromV2Surface: no supported walkable polygons at radius 0.5324/0.4204/0.3704/0.2704

policyD1.rules: support = all-range layer 0 occupied; blocked if: no support; any all-range occupancy >= 7.5 cm below plane; near(<=2 m) occupancy 2.5-7.5 cm below; layer +1 (2.5-7.5 cm) near-occupied or all-range-occupied unless near says free; layer +1 unknown in both; any occupancy 7.5-177.5 cm in either tree; any unknown 7.5-177.5 cm in both trees

recastDetour.method: walk columns exported as flat quads; Config(height 1.75, max_climb 0); endpoints = 40 seeded (seed 7) full-body centres; associated complete routes only

isolatedObstacleSpecks.status: retained; real/artifact undetermined without reference scoring

syntheticRetentionFixture.meaning: noise-free 10x10 cm boxes rendered into the real recorded rays; tests that the classification does not erase them, not that the phone would detect them
syntheticRetentionFixture.declaredBlindSpot: anything lower than 2.5 cm above the plane is inside layer 0 and is not separable from floor in this policy

notRun: FARO scoring of any corrected map
